results.content:
Why we're different 🌍

Every research tool was built in English, for English-speaking markets. Circle Panel is the first built natively for Arabic and English — with proper transcription, RTL support, and 20 Arabic analysis themes.

And unlike tools that just bolt AI onto the side, we ground AI in real user data — verified participants, real sessions, quality-checked responses. Not routine form-filling.

Pricing 💸

Starter $29/mo

Pro $49/mo

Business $119/mo

Coming soon 🚀 — prototype testing, surveys, and a participant panel of vetted experts.

We'd love your feedback — try it free at circlepanel.com and tell us what's missing. Every comment shapes what we build next. 🙏

I'm Mostafa, a product designer who spent years running user research in the MENA market — and every single study meant juggling five different tools: Calendly to schedule, Zoom to record, Otter to transcribe, Notion to write notes, Miro to map themes. Five subscriptions, five logins, and none of them handled Arabic properly.

So I built CirclePanel — the AI-native platform that runs your entire user research workflow in one place.

results.content:
Created with AI, based on recent reviews

Looking at 70 reviews, reviewers had a great experience with this company. People frequently praise the exceptionally helpful staff and responsive support team for their prompt communication and genuine willingness to resolve various technical issues. Consumers find the overall platform extremely user-friendly, noting that it is very easy to navigate and successfully set up online courses and comm unities. Some reviewers were not happy with account management, mentioning severe difficulties when attempting to delete profiles or handle administrative permissions independently.
